name: Wix
description: Wix lets agents search the Wix developer documentation, list the sites in the signed-in account, and call Wix APIs on a selected site. Each user signs in to their own Wix account through the browser.

prompts.text: List the sites in my Wix account and when each one was last published.
How do I query store products with the Wix REST API? Show an example request.
Which Bookings services does my site offer, and what does each one cost?

apps.name: Wix
apps.description: Wix documentation search, site lookup, and site API calls, over Wix's MCP server with browser sign-in.
